station.name: Krems
station.service: GeoSphere Austria (data, klima-v2-1m homogenised), 1991-2020 means computed by Tauernwetter Forschung (CC BY 4.0)
station.note: Official GeoSphere normals XLSX (klimaportal.geosphere.at/klimamittel/klimanormalperiode_19912020.xlsx) not reachable from the run (proxy blocked, binary for WebFetch). Cross-check vs GeoSphere annual review 2023 (handwerkundbau.at/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Jahr_23.pdf): Krems 2023 535 mm = 100% of normal -> normal ~535 mm (536 here); sun 1837 h = 102% -> ~1,800 h (computed 1,801 here). Reused from facts/deep-wachau.json (fetched 2026-10-25). Krems station is the nearest GeoSphere station with full monthly 1991-2020 means; it lies just south-west of the Kamptal outline, about 7.2 km from Langenlois.

comparison_station.note: Cross-check 2023 review: 814 mm = 121% -> ~673 mm (674 here); 2003 h = 98% -> ~2,044 h (computed 2,042).

langenlois_grid.source: GeoSphere Austria SPARTACUS v3 1-km grid cell 48.4667N 15.6667E (277 m), via Tauernwetter

derived.computation: relief=e.max-e.min; gst=mean(krems_tmean Apr..Oct); dist=haversine(Krems station, Langenlois centre 48.4717N 15.6783E); warming=10.6-9.3

facts.claim: Kamptal PDO: 6 communes (Grafenegg, Hadersdorf-Kammern, Langenlois, Lengenfeld, Schönberg am Kamp, Straß im Straßertale); registered 1996-11-15; outline 19,190 ha
facts.source: EU GI register via Open Wine Atlas details-at.json

facts.claim: Kamptal productive vineyard area 4,053 ha (3,196 ha white, 857 ha red and rosé), area shares based on Weingartenerhebung 2015
facts.source: Österreich Wein Marketing, Dokumentation, 2. Weinproduktion in Österreich, table 'Übersicht Weinernte nach Weinbaugebieten 2019', p. 34

facts.claim: Vienna 60 km; Danube 7.8 km from centroid
Bedrock: 50% metamorphic rocks (schist, slate, gneiss), 43% mixed sedimentary rocks
Kamptal follows the Kamp river around Langenlois; Zöbinger Heiligenstein is a famous steep hill for Riesling
facts.source: Open Wine Atlas Study, lesson Austria

facts.claim: Krems 536 mm a year, Vienna Hohe Warte 674 mm (1991-2020)
Langenlois grid cell 524 mm a year 1991-2020 (523.8); 10.6 °C mean vs 9.3 °C in 1961-1990 (+1.3)
Krems about 1,800 h sun a year, Vienna about 2,040 h
Krems April-October mean 15.8 °C; July high 27.0 °C; WSET cool up to about 16.5 °C
facts.source: GeoSphere data via Tauernwetter; WSET bands Open Wine Atlas Study

facts.claim: Kamptal DAC: Grüner Veltliner and Riesling since 2008; from vintage 2024 also Chardonnay, Weißburgunder, Grauburgunder; from vintage 2025 only grapes certified Nachhaltig Austria or organic (producers under 5,000 l exempt); Gebietswein and Ortswein 11.5-12.5% vol, Riedenwein at least 12% vol; rules in force 18 Sept 2024
facts.source: BMLUK (Austrian Ministry of Agriculture), Kamptal DAC neu ab Jahrgang 2024
